name: ppm_vu_step
description: IEC 60268-17 VU: first-order mean of |x| (99 % in 300 ms) scaled so a steady sine reads its RMS; a 1 kHz tone switched on at t = 0, the state after every 10 ms block for 1 s.

parameters.detector: y[n] = y[n-1] + alpha (|x[n]| - y[n-1]), alpha = 1 - exp(-1/(fs tau)); reading = y * pi / (2 sqrt 2)

arrays.name: period
arrays.description: one period of the tone (48 samples)

arrays.name: reading
arrays.description: VU reading after each 10 ms block
